 "path": "programs/task-fd3cd685.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two panels split by a solid separator; mark shared occupied cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full row or column separator.
    row_sep = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    col_sep = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if col_sep is not None:
        left = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        right = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    if row_sep is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
"
